title: THE CRACKED SLAB
text: A stone slab seals this grave. A crack runs across it from end to end.
Something underneath taps on the stone, slowly, as if it has waited a long time.
The slab will not lift. It has to be broken apart.
question: Which word do you speak?

shatter.text: The slab bursts into a hundred pieces. A cold breath leaves the grave, and the tapping stops.

replies.strike: A chip flies off. The slab holds: one blow will not break it apart.
replies.bind: The slab is held fast. That keeps the grave shut, not open.
replies.observe: You see the crack clearly, end to end. Seeing it does not open it.
replies.stabilize: The crack steadies. The slab is stronger now, not weaker.
replies.anchor: The slab stays where it is. It was not going anywhere.
replies._default: The word does not fit the stone. The slab holds.

done: Only stone dust and rubble are left where the slab was.
